case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests commonly praised the hotel's spacious, clean and comfortable rooms, including large or newly renovated bathrooms, and several reviewers noted pleasant staff, a good location and available free parking. Feedback on breakfast was mixed, with some calling it very nice and others saying choices were light. Isolated comments mentioned a noisy unit that was difficult to switch off at night and a slightly dirty entrance carpet.
